description: A single clone vat bolted into the corner of the holding cell, half the size of the ones in the civic facility and none of the finish — a scarred acrylic cylinder in a steel cradle, nutrient lines taped rather than plumbed, PRECINCT 9 · CUSTODIAL DECANT stencilled across the housing. It is wired into the same resurrection grid as everywhere else, one priority tier above it: if the city has an open file on you when you die, your pattern is pulled off the civic queue mid-print and finished in here instead. The Architect does not consider this a punishment. The Architect considers it routing.
name: the custodial clone vat
